newsitem.title: USA: Dairy Mart sees Q4 hurt by price cuts.
newsitem.headline: Dairy Mart sees Q4 hurt by price cuts.

text.p: Dairy Mart Convenience Stores Inc said on Thursday that lower retail prices in core product categories will hurt the company's results for the fourth quarter ended February 1, 1997.
The company said the price adjustments were successful in attracting new and permanent customers, which is translating into higher same-store sales.
In the fourth quarter ended February 3, 1996, the company reported sales of $143.1 million and a loss of $7.5 million, or $1.57 a share.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
